name: Jude
lede: The sixty-fifth book of the Bible, in full: the letter of Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James — contend earnestly for the faith once for all delivered unto the saints; the people saved out of Egypt, the angels that kept not their principality, Sodom and Gomorrah; Michael the archangel and the body of Moses; the way of Cain, the error of Balaam, the gainsaying of Korah; hidden rocks, clouds without water, wandering stars; Enoch's prophecy; keep yourselves in the love of God; now unto him that is able to guard you from stumbling, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Contend for the Faith
books.blurb: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James: contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered unto the saints; certain men crept in privily; the Lord saved a people out of the land of Egypt; angels that kept not their own principality; Sodom and Gomorrah; Michael the archangel, disputing about the body of Moses: The Lord rebuke thee; the way of Cain, the error of Balaam, the gainsaying of Korah; hidden rocks, clouds without water, autumn trees twice dead, wild waves, wandering stars; Enoch prophesied; build up yourselves on your most holy faith; now unto him that is able to guard you from stumbling.
